contract: Independent control of the original receipt fixture: hold the genuine successful retry parent while the original run remains active. Repeat the byte-identical committed activity completion once before its deadline and again after the original twelve-second bound, then send a conflicting result. Snapshot the unchanged seven-event prefix before actually completing the original workflow. This distinguishes receipt disposition from run closure; it does not relax the pending receipt contract or reuse a failed original. All phases retain the original 35-second budget and full retry snapshot.
